description: For aos configuration files that use $ref/$env (for plain data use json_del). Same as json_del, but $ref/$env objects on the path are protected: the call fails with FollowMissing unless follow: true, which goes through $ref and deletes in the referenced file (and the matching keys of merged parts). Prints "ok FILE#/POINTER". Example: {"path": "tools.json#/tools/shell", "follow": true}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/jsonx_del.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

follow.description: true = go through $ref on the way and delete in the referenced file
